caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a doll positioned in the center of the page, with ample blank space surrounding it. The doll has a pale complexion with visible facial features and dark, centrally parted hair styled in ringlets. The doll is wearing an off-the-shoulder dress that is predominantly composed of red and black colors, with the bodice and several sections of the skirt in red, while alternating sections of the skirt, as well as circular patterns, are in black. The skirt is full, and its hemline is uneven, with the fabric appearing textured. The background is plain and unadorned, and there are handwritten words at the bottom of the page, including a name and numbers indicating a series and frame.
title: Pen Wiper Doll
